segments.title: Blood traces in DINOSAUR bones
segments.say: Scientists just found blood traces in dinosaur bones.

segments.title: 115 million years old
segments.say: And the bones are a hundred and fifteen million years old.

segments.title: Not liquid blood
segments.sub: Tiny red blood cells **turned to mineral**
segments.say: Not liquid blood. Tiny red blood cells, turned to mineral.

segments.title: Heme was still inside
segments.say: Inside, they detected heme. That's the molecule hemoglobin uses to carry oxygen.

segments.title: Meet Aratasaurus
segments.say: It came from Aratasaurus, a meat-eating dinosaur from Brazil.

segments.title: Just published in PNAS
segments.say: The study was just published in the journal PNAS.
